project: HydraCode-6: Parallel Test-Time Scaling for Claude Code
description: Python external orchestrator that runs 6 concurrent Claude Code sessions in isolated Git worktrees, evaluates candidates with generated tests and tournament selection, and produces a final patch with auditable report.

stories.title: Project scaffold and typed data models
stories.description: Create pyproject.toml, directory structure, and all Pydantic/dataclass models for RunConfig, Candidate, TrajectorySummary, TestMatrix, JudgeResult, RunState, etc.
acceptanceCriteria: pyproject.toml defines package with pytest, ruff, mypy, and httpx dependencies
python -m hydra_code runs without import errors
All model files import cleanly and pass mypy
Data models support JSON serialization/deserialization
ruff check and mypy pass on all source files

stories.title: CLI and run-state persistence
stories.description: Implement CLI commands (run, resume, status, report, clean, benchmark) with atomic JSON state persistence and graceful signal handling.
acceptanceCriteria: hydra-code run <task> creates run directory and writes run.json
hydra-code status <run-id> displays current phase
Atomic writes prevent corrupt state files on interruption
SIGINT/SIGTERM handling kills child processes gracefully
Run state is resumable after interruption
Unit tests for CLI parsing and state persistence pass

stories.title: Git worktree management and safety
stories.description: Create, manage, and clean up Git worktrees under .hydra/worktrees/<run-id>/<candidate-id>/ with dirty-repo protection.
acceptanceCriteria: Worktrees created from exact base SHA, not default branch
Main checkout remains unchanged after worktree operations
Dirty repository detected and refused by default
Patch persisted before worktree cleanup
Worktree locking prevents concurrent access
Unit tests for worktree lifecycle pass

stories.title: Context packet and prompt loading
stories.description: Generate deterministic context packet shared by all workers, plus role-specific prompt templates for 6 candidate types.
acceptanceCriteria: Context packet contains: task, base SHA, repo structure, test commands, constraints
Six prompt templates loaded from prompts/ directory
Context packet is identical across all candidates
Role-specific instructions appended after common context for prefix-cache reuse
Unit tests for context packet generation pass

stories.title: Claude Code subprocess runner
stories.description: Launch claude -p with asyncio subprocess, capture stdout/stderr, enforce timeouts, handle retries, and record trajectory.
acceptanceCriteria: claude subprocess launches with correct arguments and worktree cwd
stdout/stderr captured separately and streamed to disk
Per-agent timeout enforced with process group termination
Retry classification distinguishes transient vs deterministic failures
Exit code, duration, and output recorded for each run
Secret redaction in reports
Unit tests for runner behavior pass

stories.title: Six-worker asynchronous scheduler
stories.description: asyncio.Semaphore-based scheduler that runs up to 6 concurrent Claude Code sessions with priority support.
acceptanceCriteria: Semaphore limits concurrent sessions to configured max (default 6)
20 mock jobs complete with max 6 simultaneous
Work-conserving: waiting job starts when slot frees
Priority jobs jump ahead in queue without interrupting running jobs
Scheduler slot released after timeout/failure
Unit tests for concurrency, timeout, and priority pass

stories.title: Trajectory summary validation and repair
stories.description: Validate candidate trajectory summaries against JSON schema, attempt one repair, mark unknown fields.
acceptanceCriteria: Valid trajectory JSON passes validation
Missing required fields marked as unknown
Markdown-fenced JSON extracted and repaired
Truncated JSON handled gracefully
System never fabricates test results or file paths
Unit tests for all schema validation cases pass

stories.title: Patch and test harvesting with validation
stories.description: Extract patches from candidate worktrees, harvest generated tests, validate against base revision, and reject invalid tests.
acceptanceCriteria: Patches extracted from worktree diffs
Generated tests validated against base revision
Bug-reproduction tests that pass on base are rejected
Candidate-specific tests detected and rejected
Semantically equivalent tests deduplicated
Unit tests for harvesting and rejection pass

stories.title: Candidate test matrix and hard gates
stories.description: Run each accepted test against each candidate, store results, apply hard rejection gates that override scores.
acceptanceCriteria: Test matrix stores candidate-test results with exit codes and durations
Hard gates reject candidates for: failing required tests, forbidden file changes, test weakening
Hard gate failures cannot be overridden by weighted score
Test timeout recorded as timeout, not pass
Unit tests for gates and matrix pass

stories.title: Deterministic evidence scoring
stories.description: Configurable weighted scoring formula based on test results, scope, and static risk.
acceptanceCriteria: Scores match configured formula with default weights
Weight configuration validated to sum to 1.0
Missing tests do not count as passes
Timeout not treated as pass
Unit tests for scoring calculations pass

stories.title: Recursive tournament voting
stories.description: Small-group tournament selection with majority voting, tie handling, and distinguishing test escalation.
acceptanceCriteria: Candidates split into groups A (1-3) and B (4-6)
Three independent judge calls per group
2-1 majority winner advances
1-1-1 tie triggers uncertainty handling
Tied selection generates distinguishing test
Unit tests for voting, ties, and escalation pass

stories.title: Refinement workflow
stories.description: Standard mode: refine winner once. Deep mode: top-two with parallel refiners, adversarial test generator, and regression reviewer.
acceptanceCriteria: Standard mode refines selected winner once
Deep mode creates refinement branches from top two candidates
Distilled packet includes discoveries, failed approaches, and test matrix
Refined candidates re-evaluated through full pipeline
Unit tests for refinement logic pass

stories.title: vLLM metrics collection
stories.description: Poll local vLLM /metrics endpoint, parse Prometheus-format metrics, record throughput and utilization.
acceptanceCriteria: Metrics parser reads Prometheus-format text
Captures: running requests, KV-cache, token throughput, preemptions
Missing metrics marked as unavailable rather than failing
Unit tests for metrics parsing pass

stories.title: Final validation and reporting
stories.description: Final candidate validation, static inspection, patch/diff generation, and comprehensive report.
acceptanceCriteria: Final candidate passes all required tests
Static inspection checks for disabled tests, secrets, debug statements
Produces final.patch, final.diff, final-summary.json, validation.json, report.md
Report includes all metrics and evidence
No automatic application to main checkout

stories.title: Claude Code /hydra-code skill
stories.description: Create .claude/skills/hydra-code/SKILL.md that invokes hydra-code CLI.
acceptanceCriteria: SKILL.md exists at .claude/skills/hydra-code/SKILL.md
Validates arguments before invoking CLI
Invokes hydra-code run with user arguments
Streams progress and presents report path
Never implements code directly when Hydra workflow active

stories.title: Unit test suite - comprehensive coverage
stories.description: Unit tests for all core modules: scheduler, worktrees, runner, schemas, gates, scoring, tournament, refinement, metrics, redaction.
acceptanceCriteria: pytest -m unit passes with 80%+ coverage
All test cases from test_plan.md section 2 implemented
Concurrency, timeout, retry, schema, gates, scoring, tournament, redaction all covered
No external processes or LLM calls in unit tests

stories.title: Deterministic fixture repositories
stories.description: Create 6 fixture repos: pagination bug, cache isolation, async race, parser compatibility, misleading test, multi-file API.
acceptanceCriteria: All 6 fixtures created under tests/fixtures/
Each fixture has known bug, failing test, and correct patch
Pagination fixture: off-by-one at exact boundary
Cache fixture: missing tenant_id in key
Async fixture: race condition in counter
Parser fixture: backward compatibility broken
Misleading fixture: visible test passes but edge case fails
Multi-file fixture: parameter renamed inconsistently

stories.title: Mocked integration tests
stories.description: Integration tests with mocked Claude CLI covering parallel rollouts, test matrix, selector accuracy, resume, failure recovery, and worktree isolation.
acceptanceCriteria: pytest -m integration passes
Parallel rollout test proves 6 concurrent sessions
Selector accuracy test chooses correct patch on fixtures
Resume test recovers from mid-run interruption
Failure recovery test handles process crashes
Worktree isolation test proves main checkout protection

stories.title: Real Qwen smoke and concurrency tests
stories.description: End-to-end tests using real Claude Code against local Qwen model for smoke test and 6-worker concurrency.
acceptanceCriteria: Single worker smoke test passes against Fixture F1
Six concurrent workers run against Fixture F2 or F5
Overlapping vLLM requests confirmed via metrics
Aggregate throughput exceeds single-worker baseline
Tests marked as e2e and gpu, opt-in with --run-real-llm
stories.notes: Smoke tests implemented in tests/e2e/test_smoke.py; skip gracefully without LLM infra

stories.title: Documentation and final validation
stories.description: README.md, benchmark support, validation report, and final end-to-end demonstration.
acceptanceCriteria: README.md covers: architecture, installation, commands, lifecycle, safety, benchmarking
Benchmark YAML format with multiple configurations
Full workflow runs end-to-end on at least one fixture
Final validation report generated
All acceptance criteria from design_doc.md satisfied
